newsitem.title: ROMANIA: South Korea gives $30mln telecom credit to Romania.
newsitem.headline: South Korea gives $30mln telecom credit to Romania.

text.p: Romania and South Korea have signed an accord for a $30 million credit to upgrade Romania's rural telephone system, an official said on Friday.
Governmment spokesman Iona Rosca told reporters the credit would be used to instal telephone lines in some 60 localities in the counties of Buzau and Alba, in eastern and central Romania.
The 30-year credit, with a 10-year grace period and annual interest rate of 2.5 percent, was intended to help Korean firms operating in Romania to manufacture the needed equipment here.
Earlier this year, Bucharest and Seoul signed another accord for a $48 million loan to upgrade communications in the Prahova county. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
